title: Vatika Green Farm House
location: Vatika Green Parisar, Khuraniya, near Bilkisganj, Bhopal
summary: Farm house plots at Vatika Green Parisar near Bilkisganj — planned layout with internal roads, green spaces, tree planting, electrification, water line and sewage.
description: Vatika Green is our own farm house project at Khuraniya, near Bilkisganj, Bhopal. The layout is fully planned with farm house plots on both sides of internal roads, green spaces, and tree-lined boundaries. The colony has electrification with street lights, water line, sewage line, and park. We personally take every visitor to the site. Call us or share your requirement for current plot sizes, pricing, and to arrange a site visit.
highlights: Company-owned project — direct sale, no middlemen
Tree-lined green spaces throughout the layout
Personal guidance and site visit included

title: Kanha Dream City
summary: Residential plotted colony by Sidhivinayak Group near Rajdhaba on Neelbad–Ratibad Road, Bhopal. 25-foot wide RCC roads, electrification, water line, sewage, park, Radha Krishna & Jain Temple.
description: Kanha Dream City is a fully planned residential colony on Neelbad–Ratibad Road near Rajdhaba, Bhopal. The colony features 25-foot wide RCC internal roads with direct access from the NH approach road via CC road. All plots are demarcated with corner pillars. The colony has electrification with street lights, water line, sewage line, a children's park, Radha Krishna & Jain Temple, commercial shops, and a covered campus. Call us to arrange a site visit.
highlights: Company-owned project — direct sale, no middlemen
Direct NH to approach road CC road

title: Siddhi Vinayak Campus Phase 2
summary: Completed residential plot project near Neelbad Chouraha, Bhopal. 1 km from Neelbad Chouraha, 10 km from New Market. All plots successfully handed over to buyers.
description: Siddhi Vinayak Campus Phase 2 was our residential plotted colony on Mendori Road near Neelbad Chouraha, Bhopal — just 1 km from Neelbad Chouraha, 10 km from New Market, 7 km from Bhadbhada Dam, 14 km from Rani Kamlapati Railway Station. The project is fully sold out with all plots handed over. This established the trust behind our ongoing projects — Kanha Dream City and Vatika Green.
